title: Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner
function: Woven mesh liner for catalyst basket
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for this reactor hardware chemical processing application where HCl/H2SO4 resistance up to 200C is required beyond CP grades. Mo+Ni stabilize the passive film in crevice conditions. This rationale is driven by woven mesh liner for catalyst basket and specific design requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance at 200W fiber laser
TIG welding Grade 2 at 200W fiber laser
Hydrostatic shell test at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for woven mesh liner application
inspection: Bubble leak vacuum box (woven mesh verified)
commonFailures: Crevice under gasket seating surface - mitigated by raised-face flange 0.5mm step replacing full-face gasket — critical for woven mesh liner performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner suitable for Woven mesh liner for catalyst basket?
faq.a: Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner uses Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address reactor hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for woven mesh liner requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. woven mesh liner components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for woven mesh liner application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet woven mesh liner specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
